path.description: JSON pointer for each changed condition; / for reset_all

quote.description: Exact excerpt from this Run's user message; a model interpretation with provenance, not proof of semantic correctness

reason.description: Explanation of an AI-selected parameter; cannot replace an explicit user condition

context_ref.description: Required for a root query; obtained from context.resolve in the same Run

panel_ids.description: Optional strategy for this query only; never inherited

atomic.description: True unless an operation explicitly documents best-effort semantics.

reason.description: Reason snapshot captured when the session was created.

tunnel_status.description: 隧道运行状态;direct 形态为空。隧道断开不等于 Collector 故障

address.description: Connector 注册前可以为空，注册后由可信 enrollment 回填

architecture.description: 连接测试探测的目标架构(uname -m 归一化),Linux 连接测试必须成功识别架构,Collector 安装按此选择签名产物

relay_address.description: Connector 首次成功监听后自动上报的成员拨号地址

url.description: Repository base URL or oci://registry/path/chart; no user info, query or fragment

digest.description: Optional expected archive SHA256 for repository or manifest SHA256 for OCI

plain_http.description: Explicitly permit HTTP for this source; TLS redirects/downgrades remain rejected

auth_url.description: Explicit trusted cross-origin OCI token service URL, without query or fragment

ca_pem.description: Additional CA certificates only; no private keys or disabled TLS validation

chart_archive.description: Protected packaged .tgz chart; never a URL or shell command

values.description: Protected YAML/JSON values; not included in public previews or model context

secret_values.description: Protected Secret values; excluded from public manifests, action plans and Agent inputs.

key.description: One-time interactive portal response. Never cache, persist, log, or pass to model tools.

ca_pem.description: Public certificate PEM only; private keys and authentication material are rejected.

effective_assignment_epoch.description: Epoch of the verified execution assignment; zero before first successful configuration.

effective_collector_id.description: Collector of the last verified effective assignment; may differ from the desired collector_id while moving or after a failed candidate.

MonitoringBuiltinConfig.description: Certificate trust applies only to definitions advertising component_tls_supported.

MonitoringLogWorkloadInput.description: Client-selected workload identity. Namespace identity and owner ancestry are resolved by the server and are never writable input.

known_directory.description: Last observed location at plan preparation; earlier steps in this plan may change it.

interpreter_version.description: Last observed interpreter version; absent before approved initialization.

candidates_only.description: Reconcile shared variable candidates without executing panels. panel_ids is ignored in this mode.

resource_mode.description: all_authorized selects current grants; explicit preserves an empty resource_ids set

drilldown.description: Continue a sealed parent result with its published revision and effective parameters. parameters must have no overrides.

current_installation.description: Whether this source belongs to the current installed generation when this execution was frozen; not proof of active collection.

registered_at.description: Registration time of this source configuration revision.

resource_type.description: Actual identity in telemetry storage; Namespace selection remains a separate authorization boundary.

step_seconds.description: Actual frozen PromQL range step in seconds.

source_type.description: Use a registered source type from catalog.resources, such as otlp, prometheus, hostmetrics, filelog, skywalking or jaeger; never a resource ID.

capability_version.description: Use the capability version returned by catalog.resources; current supported sources use v1.

resource_mode.description: all_authorized selects current grants; explicit preserves an empty resource_ids set

kind.description: relative requires seconds (1..604800); absolute requires from and to with a positive interval no longer than seven days.

limit.description: Optional explicit log, APM or trace-list limit. Log context uses its own before/after bound.

error_filters.description: Fixed error classification for same-counter error_rate. Only literal matchers; shared dynamic scope belongs in filters. Output is a 0..1 ratio; zero traffic produces no data.

DashboardDefinition.description: Exactly one of builder or dsl, matching the containing Panel.authoring_mode.

kind.description: Metrics range queries require fixed or auto. fixed requires seconds=1..86400. auto requires target_points=1..10000 AND min_step_seconds>=1. Empty is only for targets that do not use a range step.

seconds.description: Required for fixed: interval in seconds, from 1 to 86400.

target_points.description: Required for auto: target data points, from 1 to 10000.

min_step_seconds.description: Required for auto: minimum interval in seconds, at least 1.

signal.description: Omit on display targets: they inherit Panel.signal. Required on a detail target.

source_binding.description: Omit on display targets: they inherit Panel.source_binding. Required on a detail target, including cross-signal drilldowns.

query_mode.description: PromQL uses instant or range; a metric timeseries uses range. Logs and Trace use an empty string.

w.description: Width in grid columns; at least min_w and x+w must be <=12.

h.description: Height in grid rows; at least min_h, at most 1000.

DashboardDisplayOptions.description: Presentation only. Reductions operate independently on each returned series; mean ignores missing samples and is not time weighted, sum is sample sum not counter increase. Last preserves a missing final sample. Bounds and thresholds use raw query units. Unset bounds are automatic. Draw style, stack and smooth apply only to time series. Does not change query mode, query hash or exported data.

authoring_mode.description: All display and detail targets in a Panel use this single editing source.

row_height.description: Grid row height, from 1 to 64; the editor default is 8.

schema_version.description: Exact configuration version; do not abbreviate to v1.

preparation.description: Optional deterministic lossless conversions and standard drilldowns, applied atomically with the version-checked draft save. Omission does not modify the supplied definition.

parameters.description: result.page reads sealed data only. Search, exact scalar filters and ordering apply before pagination to the entire bound collection; the cursor binds these conditions and the original presentation/attempt/authorization version. Nested sample slices do not accept filtering. Other operations retain their own parameter allowlists.

filters.description: Allowed fields: status, connection_status, severity, level, environment, namespace, resource_type, service_name, signal, type.

active_sandbox_session_count.description: Creating, running, terminating or unknown sessions that still occupy capacity.

pending_admin_count.description: Active directly bound enterprise administrators who have never logged in.

blocks_cutover.description: True only for a currently active node whose missing ACK blocks entry into overlap.

available.description: Whether the name can currently be used for creation in the authenticated enterprise. This does not reserve the name.

execution_account.description: manual 可显式绑定 Connector 实际运行账号；Windows 必须同时指定 SID。未填写不自动开放远程执行。

onboarding_control_path.description: Validate the target callback route for SSH installation; omit for an SSH-only connection test such as removal.

connection_test_id.description: 模式 B/C 必填；必须是当前有效且字段完全匹配的 SSH 连接测试

execution_account.description: Connector 当前真实账号观测；仅与已批准接入计划中的显式账号匹配时建立执行绑定。

amount.description: Recorded quota amount including estimates when usage is incomplete.

image_pull_secrets.description: 目标集群中已存在的 imagePullSecret 名称;Argus 不创建或读取仓库凭据

AlertResourceSelector.description: Resolve hosts, clusters, applications or monitoring targets with the resource tools before selecting their explicit UUIDs. Dynamic selection evaluates resource LABELS inside the evaluator's existing grants; the resource name field is not a label. 指定主机、集群、应用或监控目标时先查询实际 UUID 并使用 explicit + ids；dynamic 的 matchers 只匹配资源 labels，不匹配资源名称字段。

mode.description: Use explicit for concrete requested resources; dynamic is for intentionally changing label-selected authorized sets.

matchers.description: Resource labels only. Do not use name as a matcher to select a named resource unless that exact label was read from the resource.

resource_ids.description: Explicit resource identity selection. For a named host/cluster resolve its actual UUID and include it here; label matchers do not match resource names. An explicit empty array selects all evaluator-authorized resources only when that full scope is requested. Omitted or null selection is invalid. 指定资源使用真实 UUID；明确选择全部授权范围时才传空数组。

matchers.description: Filters actual observed metric labels within resource_ids; never substitute a named host or cluster for its UUID using a guessed cluster/name label.

resource_ids.description: Explicit resource identity selection. For a named host/cluster resolve its actual UUID and include it here; label matchers do not match resource names. An explicit empty array selects all evaluator-authorized resources only when that full scope is requested. Omitted or null selection is invalid. 指定资源使用真实 UUID；明确选择全部授权范围时才传空数组。

default_for_new_policies.description: Preselect this enabled channel in new portal policy drafts. Existing policies and explicit API/tool targets remain unchanged.

last_successful_at.description: Time of the last successful evaluation that produced the retained value and members. Unchanged on failed evaluations; absent when unknown. This is not the telemetry sample timestamp.
